Our Heritage

Crafted with Culture. Worn with Pride.

For generations, beadwork has carried meaning across African communities: identity, celebration, belonging and story, threaded one bead at a time.

Sam Beader Collection honours that tradition. Each bangle, necklace and ornament is made by hand, with bold colour, careful pattern and an eye for modern elegance.

HandmadeBead by bead
CulturalRich in meaning

Meet the Founder

Samuel Kitheka

Founder, Sam Beader Collection

Sam Beader Collection began with a love for beadwork and a belief that African craftsmanship deserves to be worn with pride, every day.

Samuel leads every piece with care: from choosing the colours to shaping the patterns, so each bangle, bag and ornament carries a story and a personal touch. Message him directly for custom orders or to ask about any piece.
